mapper.sql: G.PROG_ID AS progId, G.SUIT_ID AS suitId, G.DYPR_KIND_CD AS dyprKindCd, DK.CODE_NM AS dyprKindNm, G.PROG_DT AS progDt, G.PROG_TM AS progTm, G.PLACE AS place, G.RESULT_DESC AS resultDesc, G.STAT_CD AS statCd, ST.CODE_NM AS statNm, S.CASE_NO AS caseNo, S.CASE_NM AS caseNm, S.COURT_NM AS courtNm, S.INSTANCE_CD AS instanceCd, IC.CODE_NM AS instanceNm, STF.STAFF_NM AS staffNm, STF.HELPER_NM AS helperNm

FROM LAW_SUIT_PROG G JOIN LAW_SUIT S ON S.SUIT_ID = G.SUIT_ID AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE DK ON DK.CODE_ID = 'LAW_DYPR_KIND' AND DK.CODE = G.DYPR_KIND_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE ST ON ST.CODE_ID = 'LAW_PROG_STAT' AND ST.CODE = G.STAT_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE IC ON IC.CODE_ID = 'LAW_INSTANCE' AND IC.CODE = S.INSTANCE_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT SUIT_ID, MAX(CASE WHEN SORT_ORDR = 0 THEN STAFF_NM END) STAFF_NM, MAX(CASE WHEN SORT_ORDR = 1 THEN STAFF_NM END) HELPER_NM FROM LAW_SUIT_STAFF GROUP BY SUIT_ID ) STF ON STF.SUIT_ID = G.SUIT_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LAW_SUIT_PROG ( PROG_ID, SUIT_ID, PROG_KIND_CD, DYPR_KIND_CD, PROG_DT, PROG_TM, PLACE, PROG_DESC, STAT_CD, RESULT_DESC, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{progId}, #{suitId}, 'S001', #{dyprKindCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{progDt}, #{progTm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{place, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{progDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{statCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'S001'), #{resultDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM LAW_SUIT_PROG WHERE PROG_ID = #{progId} AND PROG_KIND_CD = 'S001'
